title: Redaction log
description: docs/adr/0021: one row per redaction event a document's own redaction mechanism actually applied this run - consolidated after the fact from whichever documents already redact (openapi's Overlay workflow today, ADR-0004), never a universal redaction mechanism of its own. The row list validated here, before JSONL line-serialization (redaction-log.jsonl is one JSON object per line, not one JSON array). Every field describes metadata about a redaction - which field, which document, why - and never the value that was removed, so the document is safe to read freely without itself needing redaction.

evidence.description: Proof redaction happened: the raw-private and public artifact filenames, both existing - never the redacted value itself.
